title: Total All Functions
description: Total of all government functions combined

title: Elementary and Secondary Education - Instructional
description: Teachers and instructional aides in elementary and secondary education

title: Elementary and Secondary Education - Other
description: Non-instructional staff: administrators, clerical, maintenance, transportation, food service

title: Higher Education - Instructional
description: Instructional faculty and academic personnel in public colleges and universities

title: Higher Education - Other
description: Non-instructional personnel in public colleges and universities

title: Other Education
description: Vocational-technical, special education, and state supervisory education staff

title: Public Libraries
description: Public libraries and library systems personnel

title: Fire Protection
description: Firefighters, fire prevention, emergency medical technicians, and fire administration

title: Police Protection - Sworn Officers
description: Sworn police officers with arrest powers, patrol, investigation, and law enforcement command

title: Police Protection - Other
description: Non-sworn civilian police personnel: dispatchers, records, forensics, clerical, and support

title: Correction
description: Correctional institutions, jails, detention facilities, probation, and parole

title: Air Transportation
description: Airport operation, aviation security, airfield maintenance, and airport administration

title: Water Transportation and Terminals
description: Public ports, docks, harbors, canals, ferries, and water terminals

title: Public Welfare
description: Public assistance administration, child and family services, Medicaid administration, food stamps

title: Health
description: Public health clinics, disease control, immunizations, environmental health, vital statistics

title: Hospitals
description: Public general and specialized hospitals, municipal medical centers

title: Highways and Streets
description: Construction, maintenance, paving, traffic engineering, bridges, and toll facilities

title: Transit
description: Public bus, subway, light rail, commuter rail, and mass transportation systems

title: Sewerage
description: Sanitary sewer collection, wastewater treatment plants, storm drainage maintenance

title: Solid Waste Management
description: Garbage collection, recycling programs, landfills, incinerators, street sweeping

title: Water Supply
description: Public drinking water purification, distribution pipelines, meters, reservoirs

title: Electric Power
description: Municipal and state electric generation, transmission, and retail power distribution

title: Gas Supply
description: Public natural gas storage, pipeline transmission, and retail distribution systems

title: Parks and Recreation
description: Public parks, playgrounds, recreation centers, golf courses, pools, forestry

title: Housing and Community Development
description: Public housing authorities, urban renewal, code enforcement, planning, zoning, economic development

title: Natural Resources
description: Agriculture, soil conservation, fish and wildlife, environmental protection, state forests, mineral resources

title: Central Administration
description: Chief executive (Governor, Mayor, City Manager), city council / legislature, election administration

title: Financial Administration
description: Tax assessment, tax collection, auditing, treasury, budgeting, accounting, purchasing

title: Judicial and Legal
description: State and local courts, prosecutors, public defenders, legal counsel, court clerks

title: General Public Buildings
description: Operation, maintenance, and custodial care of multipurpose government buildings

title: All Other Functions
description: Unclassified, multipurpose, or minor government activities not covered elsewhere
